title.zh: Perplexity开源新检索模型：0.6B小模型能直接查9B建立的索引
title.en: Perplexity开源新检索模型：0.6B小模型能直接查9B建立的索引

current_state.zh: Perplexity open-sourced pplx-embed-v2-late embedding models in 0.6B and 9B sizes under MIT license, featuring shared vector spaces that let developers build an index with the 9B model and query it with the 0.6B model, plus token-level 128-dim vectors for fine-grained matching and OCR-free image/PDF page retrieval.
